notes.title: Don't Be a Baby! Releases on April 15th
notes.notes: As a new developer, the game has taken a bit of time to complete but after many roadblocks, the game is finally being released on April 15th. Please stay tuned for more news!

notes.title: Escape the Crib: The ‘Don’t Be a Baby’ Challenge at Steam Next Fest
notes.notes: Join me live at Steam Next Fest for an exclusive behind-the-scenes look at ‘Don’t Be a Baby’! Dive into the whimsical world of my game as I stream the action-packed gameplay that will have you dashing horizontally and vertically, all while grooving to our fantastic soundtrack. But that’s not all – I’ll also peel back the curtain to reveal the magic of our creation process. Witness the artistry of our animated cutscenes, discover how we break the fourth wall to surprise and delight, and get a glimpse of the dedication that goes into developing a game that’s as fun to play as it is to make. Whether you’re a seasoned gamer or new to the scene, you won’t want to miss this unique opportunity to see what it takes to bring ‘Don’t Be a Baby’ to life. Tune in, ask questions, and be part of the journey from concept to reality!
